value.rationale: Mean escape, absolute variance and normalized variance are distinct motivated reliability objectives for the known sticky-wall active-escape model. A complete exact classification reveals three separated sharp optimal rates, all supported mean-variance efficient tradeoffs, and a counterintuitive relative-risk optimizer strictly dominated in both underlying absolute objectives. It is neither a trivial reformulation of a mean-optimality result nor a claim of novelty for moments implied by the published transform.
